title: Old Country Polish Cheese Lasagna
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring layers of cheese, grape tomatoes, and ferment-kimchi, served hot from a communal hot-pot vessel, perfect for a high-protein dinner with family and friends.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, combine grape tomatoes and ferment-kimchi, and cook over medium heat until the tomatoes start to release their juices.
In a large bowl, combine ricotta cheese, egg, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Spread a layer of the ricotta mixture in the bottom of a hot-pot vessel.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the ricotta layer.
Sprinkle a third of the shredded mozzarella and a third of the parmesan cheese over the noodles.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of mozzarella on top.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
